milestones.title: Pinned upstream source library
acceptance: Eight Git submodule commits agree with the lock and actual checkouts
Original upstream licences retained; adoption states explicit

milestones.title: Desktop evidence timeline
acceptance: Searchable chat/caption timeline and source-linked exports
Operator attribution never presented as automatic identification

milestones.title: Durable intelligence API pilot
acceptance: Evidence, cases and assertions survive restart
Atomic idempotency, workspace isolation and damage refusal pass real HTTP/database tests

milestones.title: Agent client transport
acceptance: JavaScript and Python clients query the real scoped API on synthetic evidence
No ALFRED registration or memory-write claim

milestones.title: Desktop-to-service evidence bridge
acceptance: Explicit operator action archives a real captured timeline
Source versus receipt timestamp basis retained; session IDs do not mix broadcasts
Renderer never holds broad operator credentials

milestones.title: Recorder source and licence selection
acceptance: Exact event connector and all direct/transitive runtime licence routes recorded
One selected accessible media source produces available stream URLs without bypassing access controls

milestones.title: Durable recorder worker
acceptance: One session has segmented media plus chat and gap records
Durable jobs, stop/retry and restart recovery; recording-active requires written media

milestones.title: Independent transcription and diarisation
acceptance: Known-audio evaluation measures text errors, speaker overlap and latency
Speech segments reference media ranges; unidentified tracks remain unknown

milestones.title: Multi-stream scheduler
acceptance: Two independent sessions collected concurrently without event/identity mixing
Live-status polling, leases, backoff, quotas and durable restart handling

milestones.title: Intelligence operating console
acceptance: Sessions, worker health, media replay, account activity, evidence and cases use the real API
Desktop and phone browser acceptance; no decorative controls implying unavailable collection

milestones.title: Context intelligence and findings
acceptance: Topics, claims, possible incidents and counterevidence reference exact evidence
Human review status preserved; adversarial transcript instructions cannot dispatch tools

milestones.title: Source-supported relationship graph
acceptance: Observed, operator-reviewed and inferred links remain distinguishable
Account identity, speaker track and real-world person are distinct objects

milestones.title: Protection missions and alerts
acceptance: Protected account, selected sources, rules and delivery preferences belong to one workspace
Reviewed/uncertain alerts show source context and capture gaps

milestones.title: Reviewed reports and evidence packs
acceptance: Report editor, redaction, PDF/JSON evidence bundle and retained source manifests
Every material finding has sources and review history

milestones.title: Registered ALFRED read interface
acceptance: Dedicated ALFRED HTTP adapter respects source/model grants and workspace binding
Revocation, unavailable service, token rotation and untrusted content acceptance tests

milestones.title: ALFRED collection controls
acceptance: Explicit bounded job parameters and independent dispatch policy
Traceable job receipt; memory acceptance never automatic

milestones.title: Paid pilot infrastructure
acceptance: PostgreSQL/object storage/queue deployment validated
Case permissions, encryption, retention/deletion, metering, billing and backup recovery
Measured capacity and failure budget before customer rollout

milestones.title: Additional source platforms
acceptance: A second permitted platform uses the same event/media contracts
Independent provider failures and credentials isolated
